item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"embedding_representation","rationale":"Cap effective item embedding norms at 0.75 to test whether stronger norm control improves generalization across all four datasets. The shared item_embeddings method applies this cap to histories, positive/negative targets, and prediction candidates while preserving zero padding, dimensions, and tying. The generated predictor imports this SASRec class, so inference uses the same normalization automatically.","edits":[{"find":"        embeddings = embeddings / embeddings.norm(p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1.0)","replace":"        embeddings = embeddings / (embeddings.norm(p=2, dim=-1, keepdim=True) / 0.75).clamp_min(1.0)"}]}],"change_summary":"Tighten the shared item embedding norm cap from 1.0 to 0.75; preserve all other training and inference behavior."}
